content.short: Caliza is a B2B platform for USD digital dollar accounts and real-time cross-border payments using stablecoins.
content.description: Caliza is a financial infrastructure company that lets businesses run US dollar accounts and settle cross-border payments in real time using stablecoins. It provides named digital dollar accounts with ACH and wire access, multi-currency business accounts with foreign exchange, and global payout rails in both fiat and stablecoins. Companies use Caliza for treasury, settlement and supply-chain finance across corridors linking the US, Latin America, Asia and Africa. Its customers include importers and exporters, marketplaces, remittance providers, payroll platforms and digital banks that want faster, cheaper settlement than correspondent banking.
